scope: Track A reconstruction and candidate-sector selection
important_boundary: The FL_QOM two-step Floquet model used for invariant auditing and the QuTiP N=6 open-chain model used for finite-time dynamics are not yet proven to be the same physical model.

floquet_invariant_audit_model.period_convention: n_t alternating piecewise-constant steps with dt=2*pi/n_t
floquet_invariant_audit_model.caveat: The framework method returns an integer label but is not independently established here as the correct invariant for the open dissipative N-site dynamics.

qutip_dynamics_model.hopping: nearest-neighbour real hopping alternating J1 and J2
qutip_dynamics_model.loss: edge rate gamma_edge=1e-4; bulk rate gamma_bulk=1.0, with disorder added to rates
qutip_dynamics_model.initial_state: single-site truncated even cat with alpha=1 and vacuum elsewhere
qutip_dynamics_model.wigner_observable: single-site reduced-state Wigner negativity on [-4,4]^2 with 31 points per axis
qutip_dynamics_model.disorder: independent uniform perturbation of local loss rates, scaled by edge/bulk baseline
qutip_dynamics_model.trajectory_sampling: quantum trajectories nested within disorder realizations

required_before_topological_claim: derive or verify the mapping from the 2x2 Floquet invariant model to the N-site dissipative chain
use parameter-matched certified W=1 and W=0 sectors in the dynamics model
freeze a complete seed and run manifest
perform cutoff, Wigner-grid, trajectory-number, solver and finite-size convergence
